profileEvidence.summary: Playful and affectionate, the Dorkie is a Dachshund–Yorkshire Terrier cross with a lively streak. Some enjoy toys and close cuddling, while others enthusiastically play fetch and learn a repertoire of tricks. Birds and squirrels can draw their attention outdoors. Coat texture and ear carriage vary among these small dogs.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: An affectionate Dachshund–Yorkshire Terrier cross, the Dorkie can enjoy fetch, learned tricks and lively outdoor exploring.
